record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. Position text is written when a skill runs and goes stale between runs; the derived line is always current and says which skill comes next. The position text keeps the agent's own narrative next to it.

## Counter-argument

Position text is what the agent actually decided; a derived rule can disagree with it and then the line contradicts itself.

payload.alternatives: the position record's text only; the derived line with no position text
payload.choice: A next-step line under the goal is derived from state by a fixed rule list and names the skill to run, followed by the position text in muted

record.subject: next-step-source
